---
title: "Research"
description: "Research by El Hadji Bassirou Touré: model transformations, consistency management in microservice architectures, megamodeling and AI for education."
---

This research examines what is lost, or added, when one software artifact is transformed into another.
This includes turning one model into another (model transformations) and a monolithic application into
microservices (consistency management). More broadly, it addresses complex systems maintained through
megamodeling. In parallel, a second line of research focuses on AI for education: teacher-centered
adaptive learning for large classes in Africa.

## Research areas {#axes}

- Software Engineering & Modern Software Architectures
- Megamodeling & Complex Systems
- Model Transformations Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Neural Embeddings
- Formal Consistency Management (Axiomatic Semantics, Formal Methods)
- Artificial Intelligence for Education (AI4Ed)
- Adaptive & Personalized Learning

## Active projects {#projets}

### SEMANTICA — Model Transformations and AI {#semantica}

Decomposing semantic loss in model transformations using neural embeddings; queryable megamodels and
Bayesian integration of new domain-specific modeling languages (DSMLs).

Related publication: [Decomposing Semantic Loss in Model Transformations with Neural
Embeddings](../publications/index.qmd#toure-semantic-loss) (ICECET\ 2026).

### AI4Nieup — Adaptive Learning Platform for AI Education {#ai4nieup}

Democratizing AI education in Africa: personalized learning paths by level (intuition / application /
formal), data grounded in African contexts, and integrated hands-on labs. Developed within DiCentre4AI
and the African Futures Research Leadership Program (AFRLP) of the Alliance for African Partnership (AAP),
Michigan State University (MSU).

### Consistency in Microservice Architectures {#microservice-consistency}

Extending the Micro-Flex framework (ICTIS\ 2025): a complete transition function, a TLA+ specification
verified by model checking, and a DSL for consistency contracts.

Related publication: [Micro-Flex: Flexible Consistency Management in Microservice Architectures Through
Megamodel-Based State Transition Rules](../publications/index.qmd#toure-microflex) (ICTIS\ 2025).

### Personalized Educational Pathways in STEM {#stem-pathways}

Adaptive systems for teaching mathematics, with the goal of increasing the number of students choosing
science tracks in Senegal.
